title: fix(plugin-detail): name the activity panel's landmark by the heading it draws, not 'Discussion'
body:
Fixes #9998
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

`RecordActivityTimeline` named its `section` landmark with a fixed `aria-label` from `t('detail.discussion')`. The visible `h2` inside that section reads `titleLabel ?? t('detail.activity')` followed by an `(N)` count. `record:activity` passes no `titleLabel`, so its region's accessible name was "Discussion" under a heading reading "Activity (N)". `record:chatter` passes `titleLabel={t('detail.discussion')}` on both of `RecordChatterPanel`'s paths (sidebar and inline), so its heading and landmark agreed. That difference between two mounts of the same component is the control.

The contract is this repo's own objectui#4118 pin, in `ReportConfigPanel.panelTitle.test.tsx`: "A speech-input user says what they see, so the landmark's spoken name must be the heading, not a paraphrase of it."

## The change (net diff against base `62597c58`: 5 files — the claimed landing site, plus the objectui#4645 changeset's prose correction the seat added in round 2)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`: the component reads `const title = titleLabel ?? t('detail.activity')` once and uses it for both the heading's title and the section's `aria-label`. The heading's markup is byte-identical to base; the only DOM change is the value of the section's `aria-label`. The `titleLabel` doc comment now says it names both.
- New pin `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordActivityTimeline.landmarkNamedByHeading-9998.test.tsx`, read through the real `en` pack and the accessibility tree:
  - `record:activity` (real renderer, no `titleLabel`): the landmark is named "Activity", the heading's title, and no region named "Discussion" exists;
  - `record:chatter`, inline path and sidebar path: still "Discussion" = heading (the control);
  - an authored `titleLabel` ("Deal history") names both the heading and the landmark.
- objectui#4645 pin (`detail-landmark-aria-i18n-4645.test.tsx`): the premise sentence is corrected and dated, and none of its 20 assertions were deleted. Its ten timeline cases now expect each pack's `detail.activity` where they used to expect `detail.discussion`. The ten HeaderHighlight cases are unchanged.
- `.changeset/9998-activity-landmark-named-by-heading.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.
- `.changeset/record-detail-builtin-label-i18n-4645.md`: prose-only correction of its timeline sentences (round 2, commit `31542304`), frontmatter untouched.

## Mechanism decisions (dispatch Zone 2, each measured)

1. **Premise**: re-read at `62597c58` and confirmed. The fixed `aria-label` on the section is `t('detail.discussion')`; the heading reads `titleLabel ?? t('detail.activity')`; `RecordChatterPanel` passes `titleLabel={t('detail.discussion')}` on both paths. The failing pin reproduced the defect before any source edit (see Evidence).
2. **`aria-labelledby`, the card's suggestion, was tried first, then measured and dropped.** It shipped in the first commit, `9eb61082`. It needs a per-instance id, because a `record:activity` and a `record:chatter` can share one page and a fixed id would collide. The only such id is `React.useId()`, and its value differs on every mount. Two existing checks compare two mounts' HTML byte for byte, and both went red on that id alone (`_r_0_` against `_r_6_`):
   - `apps/console` `record-block-record-reach.test.tsx`, whose stability control failed with the message "Find the unstable output (an id, …)";
   - `@object-ui/app-shell` `palette-discussion-alias.test.tsx`, where the alias and the canonical block's HTML must be identical.

   Both are outside this card's file surface, and loosening either would weaken it. The final route is the objectui#4118 precedent's own shape: an `aria-label` equal to the heading text, read from one variable. The name and the heading cannot drift, and output is deterministic.
3. **The `(N)` count is excluded from the name.** It is live status: `filtered.length` moves with the filter dropdown, and it is styled as secondary text. People say "Activity" to name the panel, not the count. The card itself treats `record:chatter`'s "Discussion" landmark under a "Discussion (N)" heading as agreeing, and that is only true with the count left out. Including it would turn the card's own control into a second instance of the defect. The pin still asserts that the count is on screen.
4. **Authored `aria` names**: no caller can pass one into the timeline, because it has no aria prop. As objectui#9946's closed measurement found, a block's authored `aria` bag lands on the renderer's outer container through `useRecordAriaProps`. The objectui#9556 composition pin (`recordComponentAria-9556.test.tsx`) is green and **unchanged**: its selector `section[aria-label]` still matches, and the inner name "Activity" is not the authored one.
5. **The objectui#4645 premise sentence was false on the day it was written, not just today.** The card said it was once true. The section and its `h2` were introduced together in `86c04f1ff2` (2026-05-21, the de-boxing that replaced the Card), and the #4645 pin landed in `8033ad14d6` (2026-09-09). I read the file at both shas through the contents API.
6. **axe-core / vitest-axe: not used.** A pin built on them could not go red for this defect. objectui#9946's axe-core 4.13.0 run (wcag2a/2aa/21a/21aa/22aa/best-practice) on the unfixed tree, with "Discussion" under "Activity (N)", found zero landmark violations. No axe rule relates a region's name to its visible heading.

## Evidence (final head `95fe1497` unless stated)

- **Red before the fix** (new pin alone on unfixed source): `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`. `record:activity`: expected accessible name "Activity", received "Discussion". Authored `titleLabel`: expected "Deal history", received "Discussion". Both chatter controls passed.
- **Targeted union at `95fe1497`**, from the repo root: `pnpm exec vitest run` over the new pin, the #4645 pin, the #9556 pin, the six app-shell `RecordDetailView` discussion/activity tests, `palette-discussion-alias`, `canvas-display-meta`, `PagePreview`, console `record-block-record-reach`, and i18n `raw-key-call-sites-3546`. Result: `Test Files 14 passed (14)`, `Tests 170 passed (170)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Whole package** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/` at `066dbc32`: `Test Files 198 passed (198)`, `Tests 1989 passed (1989)`. `95fe1497` differs from it only in the new pin's fixture typing (`satisfies` instead of an `as any` cast), and the union above ran that file at `95fe1497`.
- **type-check**: built the dependency closure with `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' build` (exit 0), then ran `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, exit 0) on the `95fe1497` tree. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists all three touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files.
- **Ablation at `95fe1497`**: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put the old `aria-label={t('detail.discussion')}` back in place of `aria-label={title}`. The mutation landed on disk (anchor 1 to 0, blob `3d38c741` to `abcc219a`) and ran with a restore trap. Result: `Tests 12 failed | 12 passed (24)`.
  - Red: the `record:activity` case, the authored-`titleLabel` case, and all ten #4645 timeline locale cases.
  - Green: both chatter controls and the ten HeaderHighlight cases.
  - Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` is empty, `git status` is clean. The test subject is imported by relative path from source, not through a package `exports` entry, so no build step was needed.
- **Gates at `95fe1497`**, all exit 0:
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`
  - `pnpm check:changeset-claims`
  - `node scripts/check-vi-mock-override-shape.mjs`
  - `node scripts/check-test-path-roots.mjs`
  - `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift` and `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, run at `066dbc32`; the last commit touched no call site.
- **Lint**: `eslint .` in `packages/plugin-detail` (the package's own `lint` script): 256 files per the JSON output, 0 errors. The config has no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file. The three touched files also pass with `--max-warnings 0`.

## Acceptance notes

- The pending objectui#4645 changeset's timeline sentences are corrected in this PR (prose only, frontmatter untouched, commit `31542304`), at the seat's direction in round 2: the review-tier record found it would otherwise publish a sentence this PR proves false.
- The APG-preferred `aria-labelledby` + `useId` shape cannot be used by any `record:*` block while the two byte-compare checks named above stay as they are. This is recorded as an observation, not a proposal.
- NOT MEASURED: what NVDA, JAWS or VoiceOver actually announce. There is no assistive technology in this container; the accessibility tree was measured, the announcement was not.
- CI was not awaited. If `Spec Main Shape Gate` is red, that is the known objectui#10229 drift on test files this change does not touch.
